Chapter Timestamp Formatter

Format YouTube & podcast chapter timestamps with clean text export. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Validates, cleans, and standardizes podcast and YouTube video chapter markers. Ensures timestamps are sorted chronologically, correctly padded (MM:SS or HH:MM:SS), separated by valid delimiters, and compliant with platform chapter guidelines.

How to use

  1. Paste your raw timestamp notes and chapter titles into the multiline text input box.
  2. Verify the syntax to ensure the first chapter begins precisely at 00:00 as required by platforms.
  3. Click the Download Chapters button to receive a formatted chapters.txt file.
  4. Paste the cleaned output directly into your YouTube description, Spotify show notes, or podcast RSS feed.

Limits & Considerations

Formats and validates plain text timecode strings. Does not embed ID3v2 chapter frames directly into binary MP3 or M4A audio containers.

Privacy & Security

Text formatting is executed in local browser JavaScript. Your unreleased episode titles and show notes remain 100% private on your device.
